programme.title: KUDRAT 1968: High Council
programme.desc: Selepas pertuduhan Abbas terhadapnya, legasi Kuda makin rapuh, dan Kuda kini tercabar untuk mengekalkan pengaruhnya di KUDRAT.

programme.title: Hening Cinta
programme.desc: Deeja reluctantly becomes Arfan's hospital caregiver. Despite their clashes, a bond forms—until a woman claiming to be Arfan’s fiancée shows up.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Batu 120
programme.desc: Seorang lelaki tersedar dari pengsan dan mendapati dirinya berada di Kampung Batu 120. Dia berkahwin dengan anak ketua kampung namun layanan penduduk kampung mulai dingin apabila isterinya disahkan hamil.

programme.title: Haq
programme.desc: Haq dan Bad yang dianugerahkan kuasa luar biasa mula bersengketa kerana Bad percaya bahawa Haq yang menyebabkan kematian ayahnya. Lakonan Zul Huzainmy dan Adi Putra.

programme.title: Proksi
programme.desc: Sam, seorang penggodam elit bekerja untuk 'Cybersec Corporation' sementara rakannya Aman telah menggodam dan menjual data sulit kepada kumpulan penjenayah di Bangkok.

programme.title: Pendekar Bujang Lapok
programme.desc: Filem melayu klasik, kisah komedi tiga orang sahabat baik. Lakonan Tan Sri P Ramlee, S.Samsudin dan Aziz Satar.

programme.title: Apa Dosaku The Movie
programme.desc: Kisah Sybil Kathigasu seorang jururawat yang gigih membantu mangsa-mangsa perang sewaktu Perang Dunia Ke 2 di Malaya. Lakonan Elaine Daly, Cheryl Samad dan Beto Khusairy.

programme.title: Yang Sanggup Berjuang
programme.desc: Karamjit 'The Flying Sikh' Singh berkongsi erti sebenar berbakti kepada negara, sempena ulang tahun ke-30 Astro ini buat para atlet dan veteran yang telah mencurahkan bakti kepada Malaysia.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Yang Sudi Tinggal
programme.desc: Ikuti kisah Emily, kini seorang pendidik dan bagaimana Astro mengubah masa depannya.

programme.title: Love and Run
programme.desc: Love and Run mengisahkan tentang seorang budak desa yang sentiasa melindungi ibu saudaranya. Dia dengan sengaja akan menimbulkan masalah kepada lelaki yang cuba untuk mendekati ibu saudaranya itu.

programme.title: Durian Thunder
programme.desc: Seorang remaja lelaki yang hidup dengan gejala tidak normal dengan tangannya yang ditumbuhi duri dan sukar untuk mengawalnya. Adakah duri di tangannya akan sentiasa menimbulkan masalah?

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku
programme.desc: Hannah dan Alia rakannya telah pergi ke tapak pembinaan terbengkalai untuk mencari bahan untuk saluran YouTube nya namun tanpa di duga dia telah merakam satu pembunuhan.

programme.title: Dekatnya Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah 11 tahun tinggal berasaingan, Ain dan Adam bercinta semula. Namun, cinta mereka diuji apabila Ain menerima sejambak bunga ros menyebabkan Adam cemburu dan cinta mereka gagal.

programme.title: Lawak Ke Der 2018
programme.desc: Lawak Ke Der kembali dengan siri keenam menampilkan Gurmit Singh dari siri TV popular Phua Chu Kang dan beberapa pelawak terkenal Malaysia yang lain. Ketawalah hingga kering gusi dari mula sehingga akhir.

programme.title: Bukannya Aku Tak Mahu Nikah
programme.desc: Seorang wanita menemui cinta sejatinya di Bali tetapi terperangkap dalam dilema antara memilih tunangnya atau mengikut kata hatinya.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Kampung Kuala Lambat

programme.title: Bawang Puteh Bawang Merah
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Pak Ali mempunyai dua orang isteri iaitu Labu dan Kundor. Hasil dari perkahwinannya yang pertama dan kedua mereka dikurniakan anak bernama Bawang Merah dan Bawang Putih.

programme.title: Hening Cinta
programme.desc: Deeja struggles to keep up with Arfan's impossible demands. As trust builds, Arfan begins to show his vulnerable side, just before an early-morning encounter leaves them both stunned.

programme.title: Gadis KOL
programme.desc: Piah mula dikenali apabila video memasak bersama neneknya menjadi viral di media sosial. Piah kemudian ditawarkan menjadi K.O.L di sebuah syarikat di Kuala Lumpur dan kehidupannya mula berubah.

programme.title: Yang Berani Bermimpi
programme.desc: Ikuti kisah Hael, dari pentas AF kepada nama besar industri muzik yang bersinar menerusi Astro.

programme.title: Karya 12 Vol. 2: Gadis Kosmos
programme.desc: Trilogi Kekasih Elektrik dan Aku, Mawar & Makhluk Asing di mana Bart dan Amri kini di fasa perpisahan dengan pasangan mereka. Fenomena aneh berlaku di mana seorang wanita cantik muncul mengisi hati mereka

programme.title: Yang Sanggup Berjuang
programme.desc: Karamjit 'The Flying Sikh' Singh berkongsi erti sebenar berbakti kepada negara, sempena ulang tahun ke-30 Astro ini buat para atlet dan veteran yang telah mencurahkan bakti kepada Malaysia.

programme.title: Wanita Bertudung Hitam

programme.title: The Tuk Tuk of the Fifth Kind
programme.desc: A Tuk Tuk driver strongly believes that he is able to communicate with an alien from another star. The alien promises to bring him to their Utopia planet if he completes a mission.

programme.title: Chuchu Dato Merah
programme.desc: Kisah Awang Janggut cucu kepada Datuk Merah, seorang panglima yang terkenal lagi terhormat di Terengganu suatu ketika dahulu. Lakonan Nordin Ahmad.

programme.title: Chempaka Biru
programme.desc: Raja bermimpi yang anak perempuannya telah diculik olah lanun, sebelum mangkat baginda memerintah paglima maencari dan membawa anaknya pulang keistana.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Cinta Elevator
programme.desc: Apabila 2 insan berlainan darjat dan profesion bertemu di dalam sebuah lif, pelbagai persepsi timbul di fikiran mereka, sehinggalah mereka berdua ditakdirkan terperangkap di dalam lif...

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Celebrity Peng travels to Rome for the shooting of a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Man Man, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: A trio of thieves kidnaps a baby for ransom, then becomes his unlikely guardian after discovering a deadly plot against the child.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: Bernard and Lung plan to get married when their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for all involved!

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Under Current

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Linghu Chong wishes to leave the martial world but gets drawn into a violent feud. He falls for Dongfang Bubai, but a tragic misunderstanding leads to a fatal showdown.

programme.title: Silent Code

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: Hong Kong's survival is at risk due to a radiation leak. A fire brigade is assigned to stop cesium fallout by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented disaster, can they save the city?

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: When a school bus driver is injured after risking his life to save a boy during an accident, the boy's father invites him to live with them. However, disturbing facts soon begin to emerge.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Zhou Ran falls prey to an online dating scam. Tracing the scammer's clues, she reaches a coastal town and encounters two young men. Uncovering their involvement, her revenge plot unfolds.

programme.title: Ready o/r Knot
programme.desc: A couple who first meet at a wedding & have been together for five years, question the institution of marriage from opposing viewpoints. Should marriage always be the 'next step.'?

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: In this Golden Horse winner starring Gordon Lam, a retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian drug mule.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: When a thrice-divorced entrepreneur falls for a poker dealer, who is also a cabaret dancer, they seem hopelessly mismatched - but will fate help them out?

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: A private detective uncovers his wife's betrayal during a case. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case, only to find the subject murdered, and revealing a string of serial killings.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Linghu Chong wishes to leave the martial world but gets drawn into a violent feud. He falls for Dongfang Bubai, but a tragic misunderstanding leads to a fatal showdown.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad tempered and lives alone. He decides to end his life as he feels hopeless but is saved by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: Cold War 2
programme.desc: Sean Lau, appointed as the Commissioner of Police after the success of the Cold War rescue operation, finds his reign rocked by the abduction of this wife and daughter.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: A Hong Kong drama written & directed by Kearen Pang, former talent manager Mei Fung retired to take care of her husband & son, but decides to return to work to find her value in life.

programme.title: Echoes of the Thunder
programme.desc: Nam and Fire are top racing drivers. Nam is depressed after causing a young racing driver's injury. Fire decides to compete in an illegal street car race to stand up for Nam. Can he succeed finally?

programme.title: The Ex-Files 4: Marriage Plan
programme.desc: Two brothers, Yun and Fei, face challenges in love. Yun dodges family pressure to marry after his breakup, and Fei and his girlfriend opt for a 'marriage cooling-off period' to tackle marriage issues.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Based on Hong Kong's biggest financial scandal of Ching Yat Yin, who rises from rags to become a billionaire. An ICAC investigator spends 15 years to uncover the truth behind his rapid rise in wealth.

programme.title: The Shadow's Edge
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves steals billions, outsmarting the 'Sky Eye' surveillance system. The Macau police enlist retired expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild the elite squad and hunt down the mastermind.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: Stephen Chow stars in this parody on the popular Judge Pao stories, depicting how he helps a rape victim fight the system against corrupt lawyers & officials.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart.

programme.title: My Wife Is A Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: Gambling queen, Ying Ying who is a contender for the Asian God of Gamblers competition and rescued by Gerrard but suffering from amnesia, she decided recover in time to compete in the big event!

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Victim(s)
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victim's mother and the killer's mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.

programme.title: Back To The Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lived in seclusion for 20 years until a time traveller returned to rewrite history, forcing them to defend the Qin dynasty and fate itself.

programme.title: The Sunny Side of the Street
programme.desc: A Pakistani refugee receive help from a taxi driver after his father died in a car crash. They gradually develop a father-son relationship, until Hassan discovers the truth behind his father's death.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Eddie Peng charms as possibly the most handsome Monkey King alongside Shawn Yue & Ni Ni in this fantasy-action-adventure film.

programme.title: Guilt By Design

programme.title: The White Storm 2 Drug Lords
programme.desc: In this epic action-thriller starring Andy Lau & Louis Koo, a bounty of USD $100 million awaits those who successfully capture the biggest drug dealer in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story
programme.desc: Coba turns his mother's chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair

programme.title: Love Lies

programme.title: Everything is Unknown

programme.title: Demi-Haunted

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: After being discovered flirting with his boss' daughter, Sing gets blown up, but later gets relived as his professor transforms him to be a cyborg of household products.

programme.title: July Rhapsody

programme.title: A Murder Erased

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Hsuan sets out to apprehend George Eaton, a high profile thug who has escaped to Hong Kong. With home support, can Yang take him down?

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: Written and directed by Cheng Kang, this classic film starring Yueh Wah depicts how the Sung Dynasty army's chief instructor is framed by a corrupt minister.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: If you liked House of 72 Tenants, you won't want to miss out on this humorous, fun-filled sequel complete with 10 more tenants!

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: Directed by Lee Han-hsiang and starring Michael Hui, this blockbuster confirms Hui's versatile talents as the king of comedy.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: 60s pop star Carrie Ku Mei plays pop star 'Little Lark' in her greatest role, in this romance that features some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Hidden Power of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: When defeated villain, Sung Ching-shu, restarts his reign of terror after mastering the yin and yang combination, only two swordsmen can stop him.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In this comedic sequel to the 36th Chamber of Shaolin, Gordon Liu is hired to impersonate the 36th Chamber's founder!

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: Hsu Hsia, a great kung fu actor himself, both directs and leads a team of four martial arts choreographers in his hilarious tale of 'kung fu pickpockets.'

programme.title: The Lady Is the Boss
programme.desc: A martial arts sifu and a hip marketing wiz have to overlook their differences to outsmart gangsters who are trying to take them down.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This comedy contains dramatisations of some of the funniest and most surreal film gossips of director Li Han-Hsiang's 30 year career.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: In Part 2 of this adventure, only the title weapons' union can save the 6 remaining sects which vie for mastery of the martial world.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The 'iron triangle' comprising director Chang Cheh and stars David Chiang and Ti Lung produces this explosive kung fu epic.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: Cheng Tien Chi plays a righteous priest with supernatural powers, who returns from the dead to wreak havoc against one of the corrupt kingdoms.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Director Lu Chun-ku leads Liu Yung, Liang Yun-hsin and 'Thundering Mantis,' Liang Chia-jen on a madcap quest filled with double crosses and triple plots.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: Directed by Chang cheh, this kung fu film is one of the final efforts in the 'Venoms'' genre. It features a main character who is mistaken for a clan leader.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: Winner of Best Picture in the 12th Asian Film Festival, this Huangmei Opera epic stars Li Li Hua and Ivy Ling Po in a romance that stretches across the decades.

programme.title: The Master of Kung Fu
programme.desc: In this action-packed experimental piece, an all-too-human Huang Fei-hung battles a gangster's plan to frame him for robbery and murder.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: A follow-up to the previous blockbuster, this 60's musical features an unemployed magician whose love life is as twisted as his tricks.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: Chiao Hsiung plays a bandit who steals from the rich and gives to the poor, all the while risking the threat of his evil nemesis, the evil bounty hunter Wang.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll by
programme.desc: A doctor falls for a schizophrenic old classmate he's treating who refuses to accept that her lover is dead.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: 17-year-old Wong Fei Hung is prompted to go and do battle to avenge a friend's death and protect his family honour.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: The Sword and the Lute
programme.desc: Kwei Wu and his partner go on a mission to destroy the Phoenix Lute, a deadly weapon that shoots poisonous needles and can only be destroyed by the Kan sword.

programme.title: Torrent of Desire
programme.desc: Flames of lust burn strongly in this high-octane melodrama that stars Jenny Hu, Yang Fan and Qiao Zhuang.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: The peaceful life of Golden Swallow is shattered when her unrequited suitor, Silver Roc, begins a killing spree to draw her out of seclusion. Stars Cheng Pei Pei, Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: In this saga of warring clans, revenge and the ultimate martial arts skills, Yun, a young swordsman, battles the odds to avenge his father's death.

programme.title: The Kid With a Tattoo
programme.desc: Starring kung-fu comedienne Wang Yu on a mission of justice, this film is kicked into high gear by Yuen Hua, Yuan Pin and the villainous Wang Lung-wei.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: A man is arrested after every woman he had sexual trysts with ends up dead shortly afterwards but the murders continue.

programme.title: The Emperor and His Brother
programme.desc: This epic depicts how Chen Chia Lo and his men set out to persuade the Qing Emperor Chien Lung to acknowledge his Han bloodline and join the anti-Qing movement.

programme.title: Sons of Good Earth
programme.desc: This multiple award-winning film is King Hu's first solo production, a tale of the Sino-Japanese War that ends in artistic and emotional triumph.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu, who is trying to shed his criminal side, instead finds himself caught up in an all-out gang war that comes to a startling conclusion.

programme.title: Lady of the Law
programme.desc: One of director Shen Chiang's last works, this action-packed adventure features a lone female fighter, decades before the dawn of pro-feminist kung fu films.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: A young rebel goes into legend after being reincarnated to save his people from their tyrannical emperor.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: This tale of hidden treasure features the legendary Alexander Fu Sheng as a young wushu warrior, in a film considered director Chu Yuan's best ever.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Catch superstar, Linda Lin Dai, in one of her most acclaimed roles in this story of forbidden love between a country maiden and the emperor.

programme.title: Men From the Gutter
programme.desc: From its evocative title to its gritty filming and gutsy plot, this sizzling crime thriller strikes a chord with audience round the world.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Fans of 'The Little Mermaid' are in for a delightful surprise when they see this spectacular Chinese operatic adaptation, where a carp turns into a fairy.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In this unofficial third sequel to The 36th Chamber of Shaolin, San Te (Gordon Liu) is given the task of training Fong Sai Yuk.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: This light-hearted 'a-go-go' romance depicts how three doctors pursue three beauties who play hard to get!

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Alongside the equally famous Lo Lieh, superstar David Chiang plays noble warrior monk Chih Shim, the monk who saved the Southern Shaolin Temple.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Sparks fly when a female doctor criticizes a fashion designer's creations, but love follows regardless.

programme.title: Usurpers of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: When Prince Li of the Sung Dynasty is exiled with his lovely wife and faithful warrior, Li Lan, he later commits suicide. Now, it is up to Li Lan to avenge him.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Based on the folk legend, director Li Han Hsiang presents this humorous portrayal of the Emperor Chien Lung's adventures in Jiang Nan.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: This actioner revolves around the conflicts of kung fu masters. Complications further ensue when one of them falls for a princess.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Jealousy threatens to expose the secret relationship of a 17-year-old student and her 35-year-old teacher husband.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh teams up with the Five Venoms in this martial arts saga that captures the fab five at their swashbuckling best.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: A chauffeur's daughter and the heir to a cruise ship conglomerate fall in love as they try to outwit greedy relatives who have sights on the company.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: A man comes across a secret list of anti-Ching rebel names and quickly becomes a target for Ching loyalists.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu moves to Hong Kong, a kind-hearted fellow from rural China is taken advantage by cunning characters including his uncle.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Watch as rival kung-fu schools try to sabotage Fei-hung's superior Pao Chih Lin clinic until the chivalrous philanthropist shows them the error of their ways.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: Director Anthony Chan joins award-winning social satirist Alfred Cheung Kin Ting in this delightful variation on the hugely successful British Carry On!

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: At first, a gang just wants the village locksmith to open a stolen safe, but it soon escalates into wholesale torment when they are met with resistance.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: This gender-bending tale depicts the romance between a wealthy girl and a man disguised as a flunkey in order to be employed at her house.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: Witness the exploits of Chan Chao| an advocate of justice who thwarts the plans of Minister Peng to assassinate the revered Judge Pao Cheng over and over again.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Adapted from Chiung Yao's novel, this romance depicts how a wealthy man and a sweet girl discover that they are soulmates too late in life.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: A wine shop owner's son, who finds a brilliant martial arts coach in his private tutor, foils a plan by a thief but what happens when he returns for revenge?

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Lauded as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals of the 60s, this award-winning piece starring Linda Lin Dai as a dancer who finds romance with her boss's son.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: An alluring female fairy seeks love among mortals and finds it in a man who takes care of an orphanage.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: A beauty is accused of slaying her boyfriends. After fleeing to Lantau Island, she seduces another man there.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Award-winning actor Ku Feng plays the cunning pirate Lei Chen-tien, flanked by Wan Ping who disguises herself as a boy to beat him to the treasure.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei turns human combine harvester as she hacks a path through life, avenging the death of her family under the moniker 'The Jade Raksha'.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late.

programme.title: Song of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei exchanges her martial arts weaponry for a syringe in this exotic contemporary drama by Pan Lei.

programme.title: Heads for Sale
programme.desc: Chiao Chiao stars in the popular tale of a decapitating swordswoman who will let nothing stand in her way when she falls in love with a bandit's son.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: Legend of the Fox
programme.desc: This exciting tale of revenge features cameos from the director's three most popular 'Venoms,' Kuo Chue, Chiang Sheng and Lu Feng.

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: The peaceful life of Golden Swallow is shattered when her unrequited suitor, Silver Roc, begins a killing spree to draw her out of seclusion. Stars Cheng Pei Pei, Jimmy Wang Yu.

programme.title: Opium and the Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu choreographer Tang Chia's last work is one of the greatest ever, and one of Shaw Brothers' finest movies ever produced.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A young woman, who has gone through life disguised as a boy, must deal with her family's pressure for her to marry and the love of another woman.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: A Shaw kung fu classic from 1984, this film depicts the trials of a young hero who sets out to avenge his parents' death.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: Veteran Yueh Feng made this 'Martial Arts World' saga of a masked master of the 'Black Sand Hand Technique,' starring Lily Ho in a dual role.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: Cheng Tien Chi plays a righteous priest with supernatural powers, who returns from the dead to wreak havoc against one of the corrupt kingdoms.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: Director Ho Meng-hua presents an all-star cast in this searing martial arts extravaganza that will bewitch you with its swift swordplay.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: First a hero and then his daughter try to protect Ming Emperor Jianwen infant son from rebels headed by Tien Fung.

programme.title: Sweet and Wild
programme.desc: With a twisted plot, mistaken identities, along with some terrific musical numbers, this comedy of errors featuring Li Ching is absolutely fabulous.

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: The old and the new were mixed together to create a far-out period action love story.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: In this action-packed thriller, director Lo Wei plays a fishing village bully, whose son lusts after a local beauty.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: This entertaining 'Robin Hood' epic features a hero who steals from the thieves and gives to the poor which sets the thieves on the warpath.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: A stunning snake goddess in human form seduces a young scholar before a Buddhist monk breaks up their union.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: In John Lo Mar's masterpiece, an old medicine seller and his three apprentices learn Chinese, crane, pole, and drunken fighting to defeat an arrogant bully.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Chiang Li Ping plays a scorned wife, while Elaine Chin Yen Ling is the mistress who teaches the hypocritical husband that what goes around, comes around.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: Superstar Cheng Pei-pei stars as Yen Lai, the one woman who can reunite the Kao brothers in a bid to save the Teng Lung Manor and avenge their father's death.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The film's curious title refers to two props that signal a happy beginning to what develops into a tragic love story, linking a scholar and a local beauty.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: A man is arrested after every woman he had sexual trysts with ends up dead shortly afterwards but the murders continue.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: In this chapter of the 'Journey to the West' saga, the Monkey King and his gang are confronted by a whole host of fanciful villains.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In this comedic sequel to the 36th Chamber of Shaolin, Gordon Liu is hired to impersonate the 36th Chamber's founder!

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: One of the most enjoyable musicals to grace the Hong Kong screen, this classic stars the husband-and-wife team of Peter Chen and Betty Loh.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Share the exploits of two con men vying for a horde of hidden gold. In addition to the mix is a Shaolin monk and his dangerous mute sister!

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: After an inn-keeper's daughter witnesses a perverted rape, her true love must rescue her from the greater danger that threatens.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: In this saga of two warring clans, Tsao Feng from the Flag of Iron betrays Lo, his master and teams up with the enemy. Unexpectedly, Lo returns for revenge.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: A follow-up to the previous blockbuster, this 60's musical features an unemployed magician whose love life is as twisted as his tricks.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: To save his son from being killed, the head of the Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends his son to be hidden by a master fighter. Will the boy prove a hero?

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: A chauffeur's daughter and the heir to a cruise ship conglomerate fall in love as they try to outwit greedy relatives who have sights on the company.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A motorcycle workshop owner feels compelled to damn the physical and legal consequences and go on racing.

programme.desc: In 1999, Pil-sun and Mi-na team up with cheerleader Se-hyeon to form the cheerleading team 'Millennium Girls' with seven other girls for their high school soccer team, aiming for victory.

programme.title: The Way Home
programme.desc: Seven-year-old Sang-woo, a spoiled city boy, is sent to live with his mute grandmother in a remote rural village. Cut off from modern comforts, he slowly adapts as a quiet bond begins to form.

programme.title: Steal My Heart
programme.desc: Hot-shot police detective Lee is out to get a hit-and-run driver and discovers the driver is his long-lost girlfriend from ten years ago. He tries to protect her before her crime record accumulates.

programme.title: Holy Night: Demon Hunters
programme.desc: A city descends into chaos, plagued by a demon and his followers. Holy Night, a special team steps in to bring justice to the forces of evil. Will they be able to save the world?

programme.title: Escape From Mogadishu
programme.desc: Personnel of the North and South Korea embassies must join hands to escape from war-torn Somalia.

programme.title: 12.12: the Day
programme.desc: Based on the 12.12 Military Insurrection. Chun Doo-Gwang staged a coup. Lee Tae-Shin is a commander who fights against Chun. The chaos led Seoul to an unexpected direction.

programme.title: The Ugly
programme.desc: Dong-hwan wants to uncover the mystery behind his mother's death after her skeletal remains have been discovered. The long-buried memories of her co-workers reveal a hidden truth...

programme.title: The Limit
programme.desc: Policewoman So-eun stands in as the mother of a kidnapped child. The kidnpaper demands to negotiate with her as 'So-eun' and not as the stand-in for the kidnapped child's mother...

programme.title: The Lost Choices
programme.desc: A young woman who has speech disorder is raped while on her way home. The police do not believe in her. She is frustrated and thus triggers her silent revenge against the world.

programme.title: The Man From Nowhere
programme.desc: A quiet pawnshop keeper with a violent past takes on a drug-and-organ trafficking ring in hope of saving the child who is his only friend.

programme.title: The Wild
programme.desc: Woo-chul is released early for good behavior after 8 years in jail. His friend Do-sik invites him to join the gang but he wants to live an honest life. Can Woo-chul keep his hands clean?

programme.title: Decision to Leave
programme.desc: When detective Hae-Joon investigates the death of a man who fell from a mountaintop and meets his wife Seo-rae, he starts to suspect her at the same time that he begins feeling an attraction to her.

programme.title: Collectors
programme.desc: A legendary treasure hidden in Seoul's royal tomb sparks fierce rivalry as the exacavators and others with secret agendas race to outwit each other for the king's relics. Who will prevail?

programme.title: Love Reset
programme.desc: A couple decide to divorce after two years of marriage. They revive a 30-day divorce settlement period from the court, but then they both lost memories after a car accident...

programme.title: The President's Barber
programme.desc: A man and his family get tangled in decades of political chaos when he was appointed as the president's personal barber.

programme.title: Train to Busan
programme.desc: While a zombie-virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers including a father and young daughter, a couple, and several students struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

programme.title: Miss Fortune
programme.desc: Swindler Ji-Hye is looking to make her last big score. Together with her daughter, they infiltrate the house of a cultural property broker with a net worth of 60 billion won.

programme.title: Missing You
programme.desc: When Hee-Joo was 7 years old, her father was murdered. The killer, Ki-Bum, was eventually arrested. Hee-Joo has waited patiently for Ki-Bum's release.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Swordsman Lee Nan hides in a village to escape from his enemies. There, he witnessed atrocities and people are desperate for help. The killer buried in his heart finally makes his appearance.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: Han Jung-woo is a popular star pilot. He is unable to work in any company due to a momentary mistake. He later gets a job his sister's identity. But his new job is soon threatened...

programme.title: Escape From Mogadishu
programme.desc: Personnel of the North and South Korea embassies must join hands to escape from war-torn Somalia.

programme.title: One Win
programme.desc: Woo-jin is the newly appointed manager of a girls' volleyball team which is going to disband. The new owner sold all ace players for money and asked the team to win at least once.

programme.title: The Witch: Part 2. the Other One
programme.desc: After a girl emerges as the sole survivor of a bloody raid on the research facility behind the top-secret Witch Program, she is rescued by a pair of civilians who soon realise that more danger lies ahead.
